title: Heinz Salad Cream
description:
Presenters Denise Van Outen and Graham Norton relaunched Heinz Salad Cream, photo-call, London, Wednesday 22nd March 2000. 

Fair to say this stunt did not age well (Daily Mirror, 6 Jun 2018)
